newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end mixed, T-bonds weaken late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end mixed, T-bonds weaken late.

text.p: Nov 26 - U.S. debt futures ended mixed, with T-bond futures weakening late in the day. Dec T-bonds fell to 115-07/32, the nine-day moving average, on profit-taking. A wire service quoted SF Fed pres Parry as saying inflationary pressures could intensify. T-bonds close at 1210 CST/1810 GMT and Euros end at 1200 CST/1800 GMT on Wed. Markets are closed on Thursday for U.S. Thanksgiving day holiday.
